text: {"question":"Which cosmological model is favored by both the AIC/BIC analysis of the CC, SNIa, BAO, and CMB data and also shows a significant improvement in the Hubble constant tension when DESI BAO data are included?","reference_answer":"The ΛCDM model with a non‑zero curvature (Ωk‑ΛCDM) is preferred by the AIC/BIC criteria, while the w0waCDM parametrization, when fitted to DESI BAO data, yields a lower H0 value that helps alleviate the Hubble tension."}
